thread:
Marta (sales): Hey team - CedarHealth procurement hit back with a slightly different ask: they want SOC2 excerpts, ISO/27001 scope statement (we already have a short one), a signed external pen-test letter on letterhead, and an itemized Dedicated delta including KMS/HSM options. They asked for a single ZIP they can hand to procurement. Can we assemble and confirm timing? :hourglass: 

Noah P (pricing): I can produce the itemized delta. Need sizing: they mentioned 2x A100 equiv, 2TB RAM, 3 month commit. Will that be final? Any storage or egress requirements that change pricing?

Marta (sales): That's the spec they listed. No heavy egress, just model access from their VPC with static egress IPs. They also asked if Dedicated includes extra audit support (hourly engineering time) and whether that is billable.

Leila (security): We can include: SOC2 Type II executive summary (redacted), ISO27001 scope statement (pdf), redacted control matrix excerpt, network diagram (hosted+dedi), and our pen-test attestation. Important: full SOC2 and ISO reports are confidential; we only share the executive-summary level artifacts. For pen-test letter: confirm external-only?

Marta (sales): Procurement confirmed external-only for now. They might request an internal scan after POC.

Sam L (legal): I have the pen-test letter on file. If they require letterhead + signature, ops-signing-bot can stamp it after security approves the final wording. Template link: https://redwood-internal/legal/pen-test-letter-v3.pdf. Also need the PoC scope doc signed by the customer to tie the attestation.

ops-signing-bot: Signature workflow: submit approved wording to /legal-sign with ticket ID. Estimated turnaround 24 business hours.

Noah P (pricing): Quick preliminary numbers: Dedicated delta = +$18,500/mo, one-time setup = $6,250. CMK (customer-managed KMS) onboarding fee = $1,200 (one-time) and HSM add = $2,500/mo. I'll ask pricing PM to confirm and produce an itemized CSV.

Leila (security): Timeline: I can assemble the zip (exec summary + control matrix excerpt + network diagram + KMS checklist + staging IP allowlist + pen-test attestation draft) by Wednesday COB. If they need the signed pen-test letter on letterhead, expect Thurs (legal + ops sign).

Marta (sales): Perfect. Also add a one-line note in the bundle: "POC staging is not covered by production SLAs; production SLAs apply only to billed Dedicated production commits."

Noah P (pricing): I'll post the CSV quote and a one-line billing caveat by Wed afternoon.

Leila (security): Connectivity snippet I'll include for their infra team:

```
# Sample curl to validate connectivity (use staging token)
curl -v https://staging-usw2.redwood.ai/v1/health -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" --resolve staging-usw2.redwood.ai:443:34.215.101.22
```

Marta (sales): I'll ask CedarHealth for the one-page signed PoC scope and confirm that external scan is sufficient. Tagging Sam once they return the signed scope. :pray:

Sam L (legal): Once we have the signed scope and Leila approves the attestation text, I'll route for ops-signature. Also: if procurement pushes for ISO evidence beyond scope statement, we should plan a follow-up with compliance; that'll take longer.

Marta (sales): Noted. I'll set expectation with procurement: bundle Wed COB, signed pen-test letter Thu if they provide the signed PoC scope today.
